title: Constrained Spectral Persistence Hypothesis
statement: Deterministic spectral persistence signatures emerge reproducibly across selected heterogeneous temporal datasets and remain distinguishable from trivial stochastic null models under constrained validation.

falsification.condition: If alpha exits [0.5,4.5] OR sigma > 0.85 OR cross-domain std > 1.8 OR FFT/Welch disagreement > 0.35
